# Ren Residence Bukit Jalil (www.jutaasia-renresidence.com)

> Landing page for Ren Residence @ Residensi Renaisans, Bukit Jalil, Kuala Lumpur: twin 52-storey residential-title towers by Gaya Kuasa Sdn Bhd, designed by GDP Architects. Run by licensed real estate negotiator Yee Woei Shyan (REN 46305), IQI Realty Sdn Bhd. Not the developer's website. Prices follow the developer's price list and can change; starting price only.

## Project facts (developer record, sales kit / brochure / summary 5 May 2025)
- Developer: Gaya Kuasa Sdn Bhd; architect: GDP Architects
- Address: No. 2, Jalan Bukit Jalil Indah 4, Taman LTAT, 57000 Kuala Lumpur (Bukit Jalil)
- Tenure: leasehold; residential title; 5.6 acres, elevated site
- Scale: 2 towers, 52 storeys, 1,260 units, 16 units per floor, 5+1 lifts per tower, 2 to 3 car park bays per unit
- Layouts: Type A 920 sq ft (3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms); B1 1,050 / B2 1,110 / B3 1,120 sq ft (3+1 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms); C 1,270 and D 1,680 sq ft (4+1 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms)
- Status: under construction; target completion 2027
- Facilities (podium, over an acre): infinity pool, quiet pool, jacuzzis, children's pools and play areas, basketball, tennis/futsal and badminton courts, gymnasium, yoga room, sauna and steam, co-working room, function rooms, games room, kindergarten and childcare, jogging track, gardens, BBQ and picnic areas
- Design: towers drawn in the shape of the character 人 for sunlight, cross-ventilation and privacy; 3-tier security with face and licence-plate recognition
- Location: Alam Sutera LRT about 500 m; Pavilion Bukit Jalil about 1.8 km; KESAS, Bukit Jalil, KL–Seremban and Sungai Besi expressways; Tzu Chi International School, IMU, Kingsgate International School, APU; Bukit Jalil Golf & Country Club, National Stadium

## FAQ
- Is Ren Residence a residential or commercial title? Residential title. Utilities are billed at domestic rates and there is no commercial podium traffic, which many families prefer.
- Is Ren Residence freehold or leasehold? Leasehold, on an elevated 5.6-acre site in Bukit Jalil.
- How do I get the current prices? Prices are set by the developer and may change. Ask us for the current price list.
- What layouts and sizes are available? Six layouts from 920 to 1,680 sq ft: Type A (3 bedrooms), Types B1, B2 and B3 (3 + 1 bedrooms) and Types C and D (4 + 1 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms). Twin 52-storey towers hold 1,260 units, 16 units per floor, each tower served by 5 + 1 lifts.
- When will Ren Residence be completed? The developer's target is 2027; the project is under construction.
- What facilities are there? Over an acre of facilities: an infinity pool, children's pools and play areas, basketball, tennis / futsal and badminton courts, a gym, yoga room, sauna and steam rooms, co-working room, function rooms, a kindergarten and childcare centre, jogging track and gardens.35 per sq ft.
- How is the location for getting around? Alam Sutera LRT station is about 500 m away and Pavilion Bukit Jalil about 1.8 km (a 3-minute drive), with the KESAS, Bukit Jalil, KL–Seremban and Sungai Besi expressways nearby. Tzu Chi International School, IMU and Kingsgate International School are minutes away.
- Who is the developer and the architect? Developed by Gaya Kuasa Sdn Bhd and designed by GDP Architects, whose '人'-shaped twin towers are planned for sunlight, ventilation and privacy between neighbours.
- How do I arrange a viewing or get the floor plans? WhatsApp Yee Woei Shyan (REN 46305, IQI Realty Sdn Bhd) at +60 10-827 8932, or use the registration form on this page.
